# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This book collects the documentation for **TabMaster AI**, a Chrome extension
that uses Google's Gemini AI to organize browser tabs and windows.

It contains:

- The project **README** — installation instructions and feature overview.
- **Specifications** — versioned design/spec documents from the `docs/` folder,
  describing changes made at each software version. Older spec revisions are
  kept in the book so the history of design decisions remains browsable.

See [Spec Conventions](docs/spec-conventions.qmd) for how spec files are named
and versioned.

To rebuild this book, run `quarto render` in the repository root. The rendered
HTML is written to `_book/`.
